summary.en: Alkem remains centered on branded and complex generics, with biosimilar development through Enzene. Enzene discloses strategic and partnered candidates but does not provide asset-level clinical phases on its pipeline page.
summary.zh: Alkem 仍以品牌仿制药和复杂仿制药为核心,并通过 Enzene 开发生物类似药。Enzene 披露了战略性候选药物和合作候选药物,但其管线页面未提供单个资产层面的临床阶段。

watch.en: Enzene lists Indian nivolumab and pembrolizumab projects signed with partners under CDMO.
watch.zh: Enzene 列出了其与合作伙伴在 CDMO 模式下签约的印度 nivolumab 和 pembrolizumab 项目。

watch.en: Quarterly biotech sales fell 35% year on year to approximately INR704 million.
watch.zh: 季度生物技术销售额同比下降 35%,约为 INR704 million。

watch.en: Denosumab vial presentation received EMA approval and marketing authorization in South Korea.
watch.zh: Denosumab 西林瓶剂型获 EMA 批准,并在韩国获得上市许可。
